svg.title: Windows GPT-OSS 20B: historical decoding observations
svg.desc: Zero-baseline bars show layout A 18.5, B 12.3, C 111.4 and D 106.0 tokens per second, one fixed code-task observation per layout. All report 106 prompt and 141 completion tokens. A separate historical advisory peak is 139.8 tokens per second and is not part of the fixed-code comparison. These are not AGIW acceleration measurements.
